title: Crossplay Love: Otaku x Punk
titleRomaji: Josou Shite Mendokusai Koto ni Natteru Nekura to Yankee no Ryou Kataomoi
titleNative: 女装してめんどくさい事になってるネクラとヤンキーの両片想い
synopsis: Shuumei has a problem. He’s in love with a girl who works at a maid cafe, but he’s too cool to go into a place like that without being embarrassed. But girls can go to maid cafes without seeming creepy, right? When he dresses in feminine clothes and transforms himself into “Mei,” he can finally walk into the place to meet the girl of his dreams: the lovely blonde Hana. Meanwhile, Hanae is an introverted otaku who’s uncomfortable talking to people…unless he’s dressed in feminine clothes himself. While decked out in his best dresses, he works at a maid cafe, and finds himself crushing on a young woman who regularly comes to visit him: a cool beauty named Mei! In this delightful LGBT+ romcom, two young people in love are about to find out a lot about each other–and themselves. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title: Hyouketsu-kei Koso Saikyou Desu!: Chiisakute Kawaii Shishou to Kekkon Suru Tame ni Saikyou no Majutsushi wo Mezashimasu
titleRomaji: Hyouketsu-kei Koso Saikyou Desu!: Chiisakute Kawaii Shishou to Kekkon Suru Tame ni Saikyou no Majutsushi wo Mezashimasu
titleNative: 氷結系こそ最強です！～小さくて可愛い師匠と結婚するために最強の魔術師を目指します～
synopsis: The Hermes family has produced many talented magicians. However, it turns out that only the third son, Frey, has an aptitude for the ice attribute, which is unpopular in modern times. As a result, Frey is scorned by those around him and banished from the Hermes family. "I'll show them... I'll become stronger," Frey resolves, and meets a lovely girl. However, she turns out to be none other than Arcelia, the Sage of Ice, one of the Seven Sages who saved the world. In order to become the world's strongest ice-attribute magician, Frey looks up to Arcelia as his master, but before long, his feelings turn to love. Will he even propose marriage?! (Source: Young Champion Web, translated)
